effects.title: Stop the weapon line
effects.text: Stop the metal feed at the west machine. Vent the pressure tank only when its needle reaches the pale safe band. Then pull the safety cable at the north end and reach the hammer lock before its eight lights go out. If you miss it, pull the cable again. The stopped feed and empty tank stay safe.
